finding: The RossFast workunit base does not contain the later F-LMFP06-09 experimental steady-Darcian face-oracle implementation. Copying that implementation into RossFast or rebasing RossFast onto an unmerged LayeredMFP experimental branch would create avoidable duplicate hydraulics or branch coupling.
architectural_rule: RossFast and LayeredMFP should share a solver-neutral experimental/reference face-oracle contract once that code is extracted or otherwise made available from an authoritative common base. Production solvers must not own competing copies of SWAP hydraulic constitutive physics.
prototype_sequence: reconstruct and test Ross2011 continuity/time-discretization algebra independently of hydraulic model details
use a minimal analytic hydraulic fixture only for algebraic mass and tridiagonal-solve tests
before SWAP-hydraulic qualification, depend on a common authoritative h(theta), theta(h), K(h) and steady-Darcian face reference rather than copying F-LMFP internals
cross-qualify Ross face tables against the same direct Darcian oracle used by LayeredMFP
keep offline table generation outside persistent per-column state
blocker_for: claiming direct quantitative equivalence of Ross tables and F-LMFP face tables on the latest envelope
